details: Shipping traffic in the Strait of Hormuz has significantly decreased as renewed hostilities between the United States and Iran escalate. This development poses a new challenge to energy markets, already affected by major supply disruptions. Maritime intelligence indicates that no large vessels have publicly broadcast their location while transiting the US-coordinated route since Tuesday, and traceable crossings via the Oman-hugging lane have nearly halted. The plunge in traffic follows renewed US strikes on Iranian targets and Iranian attacks on commercial shipping in the vital waterway.
title: Strait of Hormuz Traffic Plunges Amid US-Iran Fighting

details: The United States has revoked a temporary authorization that allowed Iran to sell its oil, a measure that had been in place for just over two weeks. This reversal by Washington comes after several tanker attacks near the Strait of Hormuz. The US Treasury Department's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) has issued a new license, effective July 7, to wind down existing transactions until July 17, but it prohibits new purchases or loading of Iranian crude oil and petroleum products. This move eliminates a rare sanctions relief at the core of US-Tehran negotiations.
title: US Ends Iran's Brief Oil Export Opening After Tanker Attacks

details: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has reduced its 2026 global economic growth forecast for the second time this year. The downgrade, announced on Wednesday, attributes the cut primarily to the "lingering effects" of the energy shock resulting from the US-Israel war on Iran. The global economy is now projected to grow by 3 percent in 2026, a "modest slowdown" from April's 3.1 percent forecast, although partly offset by AI-driven demand. Global inflation is expected to reach 4.7 percent this year.
title: IMF Cuts 2026 World Growth Forecast Citing Iran War Fallout

details: Labour Members of Parliament are set to rebel against the government's proposed political funding reforms next week, advocating for stricter measures that include a complete ban on cryptocurrency donations and lower spending limits. This push for a permanent ban on digital currency donations, rather than the government's temporary moratorium, is gaining widespread support among Labour MPs. The move comes amid ongoing controversies surrounding the funding of the Reform UK party, including significant donations from a cryptocurrency entrepreneur.
title: UK Labour MPs Push for Total Cryptocurrency Ban in Party Funding
